faq.title: Package questions
faq.description: How ordering, delivery, revisions and refunds work.

deliveryStart.question: When does the delivery time begin?
deliveryStart.answer: The delivery period starts once we have received the 50% deposit and all the customer information the package requires.

deposit.question: What deposit is required?
deposit.answer: A 50% deposit is required to begin. The remaining amount is due on delivery, and the balance is paid before the final files are handed over or the site goes live.

revisions.question: How many revisions are included?
revisions.answer: Two revision rounds are included. Both rounds must be requested within seven days of delivery. Later changes use the configured add-on pricing.

ownership.question: Who owns the final work?
ownership.answer: You own the delivered files and the website, and the domain is registered in your name. Third-party services and domain costs are charged at cost.

thirdParty.question: Are domains and third-party services included?
thirdParty.answer: No. A custom domain and any third-party service are charged at cost, and the amount is confirmed separately rather than added to the package price.

guarantees.question: Are jobs, clients, sales or search rankings guaranteed?
guarantees.answer: No. No job placement, client acquisition, sales or search ranking is guaranteed. The packages deliver the listed work, not a commercial outcome.

cancellation.question: What happens if I cancel?
cancellation.answer: Before work starts, the deposit is refunded in full. After work starts, the completed portion of the work is charged.

faq.title: Questions clients ask before they begin
faq.description: A clear overview of how Helaly works, what we build, and how projects move forward.

webSolutions.question: What types of websites and digital solutions do you offer?
webSolutions.answer: Helaly works on business websites, landing pages, marketing-focused experiences, and digital systems designed around clear business goals. Each project is shaped around the needs of the brand, the audience, and the experience you want to create.

startProject.question: How do I start a project?
startProject.answer: The easiest next step is to share your request through the project form. We review the details, understand your goals, and use that information to shape the right direction for your website or digital experience.

businessTailored.question: Can I request a website tailored to my business?
businessTailored.answer: Yes. Every project is planned around your business goals, audience, and priorities. We tailor the structure, messaging, and experience so it reflects your brand rather than using a one-size-fits-all approach.

responsiveDesign.question: Will my website work on mobile, tablet, and desktop?
responsiveDesign.answer: Responsive design is part of how we approach digital experiences. We aim to make the site comfortable and usable across common screen sizes so visitors have a consistent experience on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

changesDuringProject.question: Can I request changes during the project?
changesDuringProject.answer: Yes, collaboration is part of the process. We review changes as the project develops, clarify priorities, and keep the scope aligned so the final experience supports the original goals without unnecessary confusion.

examples.question: Can I see examples of previous work?
examples.answer: We can share relevant examples and project context when available. This helps clarify the type of work, visual direction, and digital experience we can help create for your business.

projectCost.question: How is the project cost determined?
projectCost.answer: Project pricing depends on the scope, complexity, and requirements of the work. We review the project goals, the services involved, and the level of customization needed before proposing a suitable approach.

contactBeforeRequest.question: How can I contact you before submitting a request?
contactBeforeRequest.answer: You can reach out through the contact page or start with a project request if you already know what you need. Either way, we are happy to learn more about your goals before moving forward.
